'''Tergamenion''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. A [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|darkworld]], it served as a base for the [[Daimanate|Daimanite]] military industrial complex during the [[Republic Dark Age|Republic’s Dark Age]].

==History==
[[File:Lord_Daiman.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Daiman]], under whose rule Tergamenion was during the [[Second Charge Matrica|Second ''Charge Matrica'']].]]

During the [[Second Charge Matrica|Second ''Charge Matrica'']] in the Republic Dark Age, the world was under the control of a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], [[Daiman]]. According to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Intelligence]], Tergamenion was the site of research and production complexes that produced [[Night vision/Legends|night-vision]] equipment and advanced targeting systems for the Daimanite armed forces.<ref name="Atlas Extra" />

Shortly before the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led [[Operation Influx]] of [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vannar Treece]] briefly described the planet in his report to the Republic [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Genarra]], noting that the facilities on Tergamenion were critical to the Daimanite war effort, but that the world was too remote for an effective Republic strike.<ref name="Atlas Extra" />

Roughly six weeks after this observation by Genarra,<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://scifi.about.com/od/starwarspeople/a/Interview-With-John-Jackson-Miller_2.htm|text=John Jackson Miller interview with About.com|archivedate=20110122133120}}</ref> Sith Lord [[Ayanos Bactra]] established an [[arxeum]]—a mobile war-sciences university—located near Tergamenion. He offered the institution to Daiman himself, in exchange for safe passage across his territory in order to strike at [[Vellas Pavo]]. Daiman agreed to the offer; however, he chose the facility near [[Gazzari]].<ref name="Knight Errant novel">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']]</ref>

Later that year, following the [[Aquilaris campaign]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] visited Tergamenion, where she established contact with Daiman in a bid to defeat Sith Lord [[Odion]] and to gain information on her parents [[Aron Holt|Aron]] and [[Mercia Holt]]. With Daiman's cooperation, Kerra disguised herself as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] named 'Mercy', and established contact with [[Wayman]], an undercover [[Claimer]] working for Odion as a [[Recruitment Agent|recruitment agent]]. Kerra was, subsequently, able to infiltrate the [[Odionate]] and join the [[Novitiate]]s, an elite [[Corps/Legends|corps]] of darksiders subservient to Odion. She was also informed about [[Project Pandemonium]], a research-project aimed at locating the [[Helm of Ieldis]] (an ancient [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] capable of driving sentient beings into a murderous frenzy).<ref name="SWKE11">[[Knight Errant: Escape 1|''Knight Errant: Escape'' 1]]</ref>
